title: The Star-Crossing Citadel
datum: The top of the orrery court paving is Y=0. Plan north is +Z, east is +X, and dimensions are in meters.
intent: From the far bridge, the amber star window marks the destination. The ascent beyond the gate follows the orrery sightline, framing the high library between the low workshops.
assembly: Use the same curve vertices for the outside parapet face, deck edge and top of the retaining wall. The parapet ends at the top of its masonry with no projecting plinth or applied band.

table: floor directly below the center of the tabletop
case: floor directly below the center of the back panel, with shelves facing south
press: center of the screw on the worktable

materials: Matte stone with long horizontal courses. Align the joints across the court and grand stair walls.
Lay the stair slabs across the direction of travel and use broad, subdued paving in the court.
Irregular rock with large fracture faces. Taper the silhouette below the terrace.
Run the short axis of the overlapping tiles down the roof slope.
Reserve for sills, voussoirs and capitals, where shadows define the profile.
Use warm brick and signs of wear in the bindery to distinguish it from the cool stone of the main hall.
Align the grain with the long axis of machinery, bookcases and writing desks.
Use small areas of color on vertical gate banners and bound volumes.
Reserve for the orrery rings, pulley and restoration motif.
Set the glazing inside the window. Keep the lead dark and warm the transmitted light only during restoration.

assemblies.name: arrival island and three-arch bridge
assemblies.layout: Place each bridge arch crown 1.25 below the deck, with the pier axes at the span boundaries. Set a brazier on each side of both interior boundaries.

assemblies.name: orrery court and round-tower gate
assemblies.layout: Place 12 merlons and 12 upper embrasures on each tower at 30° intervals. Hang a vertical banner on the south face and top each tower with a flagpole and flag. Use three intersecting ecliptic rings on the orrery.

assemblies.name: west star walk and observatory
assemblies.layout: Build arches on both sides of all five walkway spans. Place a support column on either side beneath the second and fourth spans.

assemblies.name: east arcade
assemblies.layout: Use a column base radius of 0.51 and a height of 3.10. Seat the pointed arches between adjacent capitals and fill the spandrels with masonry to support the continuous cornice.

assemblies.name: grand stair and upper terrace
assemblies.layout: Set braziers on both sides at the start of the first flight and the landing. Center each base 0.31 m inside the parapet and embed its lower 0.16 m in the sloping paving. Keep the landing between flights level.

assemblies.name: great library
assemblies.layout: The four corner spires and the main roof define the silhouette. Divide the central star window with a rose ring 1.45 in diameter, an eight-rayed restoration motif and lead cames.

assemblies.name: west bindery
assemblies.layout: Use a simple gable roof and side windows. Place the low sewing frame to the east, the tall press to the west and the horizontal shelf to the north. Leave a 1.40 m visitor aisle. Use the work layout for dimensions and origins.

assemblies.name: east freight warehouse
assemblies.layout: Set the fixed mast at (30.5,8.2) with a jib radius of 4.60. In the fourth restoration phase, lift for 3.2 seconds, turn for 3.6 and lower for 2 seconds onto the paving at (30.5,12.8). Place the 2.40-wide receiving door at Z=11.4 on the east wall. Use the work layout for the stacked crates.
parts: east freight warehouse foundation outer wall

assemblies.name: west reading wing
assemblies.layout: Place four buttresses along the west side. Set the desktop at 0.76, the seat at 0.44 and the back at 0.83 m. Leave at least 1.20 m behind the seats and 0.45 m of knee clearance under the front of the desk. Keep the south door and sightline clear.

assemblies.name: east folio library wing
assemblies.layout: Place four buttresses along the east edge. Set both bookcases against the east side and keep the west wall entrances to the corridor and shortcut clear.

assemblies.name: ramparts and battlements
assemblies.layout: Use one cross section for the parapet wall and a merlon spacing of 2.05. Leave the sloping stair runs free of merlons.

districts.name: Starsea landing
districts.asset: Basalt island, flagstones and low ramparts
districts.place: Build the island along its perimeter vertices. Keep the northeast bridge connection and west unloading edge open.
districts.style: Blue basalt fracture faces support the edge of the pale paving.
districts.collision: Floor and ramparts are solid. The open west edge allows falls.

districts.name: Three-arch stone bridge
districts.asset: Stone deck, three arch spans, piers and merlons
districts.place: Construct both edges from the nine stations. The first and last cross sections form the joints with the landing and court.
districts.style: Use a long, windowless masonry silhouette. Keep the arch recesses and piers in shade.
districts.collision: Deck and parapets are solid. Players can walk the deck in both directions.

districts.name: Twin-tower gate
districts.asset: Round towers with cut inner bearing faces, two jambs and a pointed arch
districts.place: Set the tower axes at (±4.30, -1.00). Seat the gate frame against the flat inner face of each tower.
districts.measure: Tower diameter 4.00, gate width 4.80, gate capitals +4.25, top +7.72
districts.style: Embed the tower bases in the ground and expose the dark banners and brass above.
districts.collision: Tower bodies and jambs are solid. Keep the central opening passable.

districts.name: Orrery court
districts.asset: Fan-shaped paving, brass orrery on a stone pedestal and six eastern arches
districts.place: Set the orrery axis at (1,9). Place seven arcade columns 0.70 inside boundary edges 2 through 7 on the east side.
districts.measure: Floor ±0.00, nominal orrery radius 1.55, arcade top +5.44
districts.style: Keep the center of the court open and the sky visible through the arches. Keep the lower ornaments above the bedrock.
districts.collision: Orrery sweep, pedestal, columns and parapets are solid.

districts.name: Star walk and observatory
districts.asset: Curved west rampart walk, round observation platform and small orrery
districts.place: From the west fork of the court, follow six stations to the round platform at (-30,15.8).
districts.style: Set the stars above a low sightline and keep the brass orrery small in silhouette.
districts.collision: Deck, ramparts and orrery are solid.

districts.name: Grand stair and terrace
districts.asset: Two flagstone flights, a level landing, integrated retaining walls and parapets
districts.place: Center on X=0. Share cross sections at Z=19,24,26.5,32.5. Carry each outer wall down to the slab and bedrock in one profile.
districts.style: Use plain faces to show the changes in slope. Keep the outside free of applied bands.
districts.collision: The continuous ramp and parapets carry collision. Individual treads form the visible surface above the ramp.

districts.name: west bindery
districts.asset: Brick workshop, gable roof, sewing frame, book press, horizontal shelf and stool
districts.place: Footprint [-23,-13]×[-1,6], east entrance (-13,2.5). Use the work layout origins for the east sewing frame, west press and gathering shelf on the north wall.
districts.style: Use matte brick and dark wood. The gathering on the frame and the stored sheets return after the second restoration.
districts.collision: Walls, jambs, worktable, press, shelf, stool and chimney are solid. Cords and paper allow passage.

districts.name: East freight dock
districts.asset: Timber-frame warehouse, sliding receiving door, fixed footing, rotating jib, pulley and cargo
districts.place: Footprint [18,29]×[4,13], west door (18,8.5), hoist axis (30.5,8.2), landing (30.5,12.8), east receiving door (29,11.4). Both lanes follow the work layout.
districts.measure: 11 × 9, eaves +5.10, ridge +7.45, west door 4.30, receiving door 2.40 × 2.60
districts.style: Use an indigo roof, walnut and aged brass. On the fourth restoration, the cargo rises, turns 90° and lands.
districts.collision: Warehouse, crates, footing, mast, sliding door and moving cargo are solid. Update the door and cargo colliders with their meshes every frame.

districts.name: Great library main hall
districts.asset: Central nave, four corner towers, south pointed doorway and star window
districts.place: Set the south facade at Z=36. Align the main door and photograph desk with the grand stair. The route continues from the north arch into the eastern folio library.
districts.style: Make the star window 8.00 wide. Recess the leaded glass 0.20 behind the stone facade and light the central star during restoration.
districts.collision: Walls cut to the door frame, door leaves, desks, bookcases and corner towers are solid.

districts.name: West reading wing and east folio library
districts.asset: Paired gabled library wings, sills, mullions, reading desks and folio bookcases
districts.place: Align the south facades with the main hall at X=±15.50. Cut separate openings for the corridor and return passage in the west wall of the east wing.
districts.measure: Each wing 12 × 23, eaves +12.70, ridge +16.50, south door width 2.80
districts.style: The west wing is for reading and the east wing holds sealed records. Light each area as its records are discovered.
districts.collision: Floors, walls, bookcases and benches are solid. The two passages follow their door locks.
